dict.string: The camera takes the photo this app signs, and reads the pairing QR code on the laptop.
The position at the moment of the photo is sealed in the capture. Only the area you choose is published.
The location proof needs the precise position to place the photo in the right cell.
The share sheet can save a copy of the signed file to Photos.
The app sends captures to provenance serve on the laptop on this network.
Face ID unlocks the Secure Enclave key that signs each capture.
